title.narrative: Strengthening Church Civil Society and Political Party relations in Swaziland

description.narrative: This Project works to strengthen the strategic linkages and relations between the Catholic Church, Civil Society and political parties in Swaziland following on from years of fragmentation and lethargy in the broader struggle for democratisation in Swaziland. Using the Dennis Hurley's position as a credible broker and mediator the Project will therefore support a series of meetings and capacity strengthening interventions aimed at building consensus and establishing a cohesive multi-stakeholder approach. The Project is rendered imperative by the release of the falsely imprisoned leaders of banned political parties whose presence in the field has provided new impetus for different stakeholders to work towards a common way forward. Expected results for the Project include: i. strengthened capacities of church, Civil Society and political party actors in multi-stakeholder approaches to democracy; ii. brokered consensus on joint actions and ways of working for church, civil society and political parties; iii. shared understanding of strategic roles and responsibilities of church, civil society and political parties actors in the promotion of democracy in Swaziland.
